pairs.registryProposal: archive-extraction-safety is written for multi-entry archives that are written to disk. A single-stream decompression (gzip to an in-memory JSON parse) has only the bomb class and none of the slip class. The technique could say outright that a per-call output budget (e.g. maxOutputLength) is the whole defense in that case, and that digest verification cannot be done when the publisher ships no digest.
